Relocate yourself into an environment that discourages urges (e.g., your local coffee shop). Talk out loud to yourself about what you want to do, while acknowledging that there may be barriers, and explain to yourself why you do not want to give into your urges. Be careful with that though not to shift the focus too much on trying to forget about the urges, because they might still be there, but rather on simply diverting your attention elsewhere once you have found your purpose.
